# Arise Community Support Foundation (Arise CSF)

> Official website: https://www.arisecsf.org
> Organization type: Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) / Non-Profit
> Founding Year: 2007
> Founder: Rex Osagiede
> Headquarters: Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria
> Primary Mission: "Connecting caring hearts with lives in need."

## Overview
Arise Community Support Foundation (Arise CSF) is a registered non-profit, non-governmental humanitarian organization established in 2007 by Rex Osagiede in Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria. For nearly two decades, Arise CSF has worked at the grassroots level to reduce poverty, advance healthcare access, empower youth, and preserve the dignity of senior citizens.

## Ways to Support & Partner
- **Education Scholarships**: Sponsor a deserving student’s education by supporting school fees, books, learning materials, or exam registrations. Partner with Arise Education Scholarship Foundation to support more students through their education.
- **Diabetes & Hypertension Support**: Donate diabetes and hypertension medicines, screening equipment, test strips, and other essential supplies. Sponsor free community screenings and awareness campaigns.
- **Cultural Awareness & Community Programmes**: Sponsor programmes that promote cultural knowledge, preserve heritage, and encourage learning across generations, including activities at The Igiogbe.
- **Youth & Leadership Development**: Support mentoring, skills development, digital literacy, and leadership programmes that help young people discover their potential and contribute to their communities.
- **Senior Citizens Support**: Contribute towards the care, welfare, and practical needs of older members of our communities.
- **Administrative & Operational Support**: Help sustain the Foundation’s work by contributing towards programme coordination, logistics, administration, and essential running costs.

## Contribution & Partnership Inquiries
To protect donor security and coordinate personal support, the Foundation does not publish bank accounts publicly. Supporters are invited to contact the Foundation directly to discuss their preferred area of support, after which relevant contribution or payment details are shared privately.

## Key Leadership
- **Rex Osagiede**: Founder and Visionary Leader. Dedicated grassroots humanitarian who has led medical outreaches, scholarship programs, and community advocacy since 2007. Detailed profile: https://www.arisecsf.org/rex-osagiede
